A '''transport force''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[systems admiral]]. It was comprised of two [[troop squadron]]s, a [[heavy squadron]], and a [[light squadron]], for a total average of eighty [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Although they were primarily employed to transport and deploy troops belonging to both the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] to battle, the transport forces were used as command centers for coordinated ongoing surface operations.
